issues.description: Lecture constructor parameter order is inconsistent with the problem statement/UML. The statement says the constructor should follow UML attribute order: (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors), but the reference solution defines: Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents). This can cause students to implement a different constructor signature than expected by the exercise/tests and to pass arguments in the wrong order.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution constructor signature (and expected usage/tests) to match the UML/problem statement order: Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors), or update the problem statement/UML to reflect the intended constructor parameter order if the current order is intended.
